# CaptureAudioScene <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CaptureAudioScene:Void scene:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scene` | In | Int32 | required | A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Fills a scene with what everything is at right now: the volume of every bus, every parameter and the bypass of every bus effect, and every listener setting. Applying it later brings all of it back. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* What the scene held before is forgotten.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
saved = CreateAudioScene()
CaptureAudioScene saved
ApplyAudioScene cutscene, 500
; ... the cutscene ...
ApplyAudioScene saved, 500
```
